children: Completion of second tranche of share repurchase programme
Kingfisher plc ("Kingfisher") announces that the second tranche of the £300m share repurchase programme announced on 24 March 2026, to purchase its shares for cancellation, has now completed.

Goldman Sachs International, who undertook the second tranche on Kingfisher's behalf (as announced on 16 July 2026), purchased 16,124,103 shares for a total consideration of £50m. As a result, Kingfisher has now returned £125m of the £300m share repurchase programme.
Further details on the third tranche of the share repurchase programme will be announced in due course.
